quotes.text: When greed appeared, they adjusted their offerings accordingly, teaching through measured response rather than abandoning the bridge entirely.
When their partner returned fairly, they gave more freely in future crossings.
"The Foundation Rhythm: send four coins, return six coins.
When you receive, return half reliably—six from twelve, five from nine.
You keep one or two plus six returned—total seven or eight. They keep six.
An elder spoke: "What of those who send little or return less?"
When you recognize a soul who honored their covenant before—who sent generously then, who returned fairly then—celebrate the reunion.
Do not judge your partner by one clouded exchange—watch the pattern across many crossings.

note: Bridge Guardian: adjust but never abandon the bridge; simplifies to Foundation Rhythm send four, return six; rebuts two-thirds as too complex.
